item.title: Surfer Uriah McDonald Is the World’s Gnarliest 8-Year-Old
item.description: At just eight years old, Uriah McDonald has already paddled out at Pipeline and Teahupo'o. He's got the stoke. And when you have the stoke, anything's possible.

item.title: Kelly Slater on Diet, Training, Motivation, and Future Plans
item.description: In the Ultimate Human Podcast, Kelly Slater sat down to talk about what he's done to keep himself in fighting shape for three decades of surfing dominance.

item.title: Teens Arrested in San Diego County After ‘Train Surfing’ Video Goes Viral
item.description: Both individuals admitted to riding on top of the train. They were subsequently arrested for trespassing on railroad property. No injuries were reported.

item.title: Koa Rothman Surfs Two Days of Pipeline Perfection
item.description: Koa Rothman loves to surf Pipeline, and over the course of the last few days, he got his fill of his all-time favorite dish. Two straight days of perfect Pipe.

item.title: Surfer ‘Shot Out of the Water’ by Shark in California
item.description: A Northern California surfer experienced a shark attack that left him with stitches in his upper thigh and half a board missing.

item.title: Want to Be a Big Wave Photographer? Here’s What I Had to Learn
item.description: Big wave surfing captures imaginations. And photographing giant waves is an animal all its own. A writer shares what she had to learn to understand the pursuit.

item.title: Australian Runner Takes Wrong Turn, Continues for 30 Miles Before Rescue
item.description: Australian runner Bodhi Jackson took a wrong turn and ended up running over 30 miles through rugged terrain in New South Wales' Snowy Mountains.

item.title: Colorado’s Mid-Winter Snowpack Is Currently the Worst Ever
item.description: Colorado is at just 62 percent of its expected snow levels for this time, less than two-thirds of what should have fallen throughout the winter.

item.title: Here’s What Happens When 3 of Australia’s Top Upcoming Girls Head to G-Land
item.description: When Charli Hatley, Ziggy Mackenzie, and Isi Campbell, three of Australia's top upcoming girls headed to G-Land, it was a real sight to see.

item.title: Hikers Rescued After Three Nights in Emergency Shelter
item.description: A group of four hikers found themselves trapped in an emergency shelter for three days in British Columbia's Golden Ears Provincial Park this week.
